question: Which percussionist from Maharashtra received Padma Vibhushan 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zakir Hussain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Zakir Hussain**, the tabla maestro from Maharashtra, was awarded the **Padma Vibhushan in 2023** for his outstanding contributions to Indian classical music and percussion.
 
• He is globally recognized as one of the finest tabla players and has played a pivotal role in popularizing Indian percussion on the international stage.
